analysis.title: Flowserve Corp. (FLS): Solid 3Q beat, raising estimates on margin strength and record backlog
key_insights: FLS reported a 3Q26 segment EBIT beat of +5% vs. FactSet consensus, driven by stronger margins in FPD (+7% on EBIT vs. FactSet consensus). Segment operating margin was 20.0%, above consensus.
3Q26 bookings were $1.38bn, +8% organic y/y (book-to-bill 1.12x), including record aftermarket bookings of $728mn (+11% y/y). 2Q bookings were $1.35bn.
FLS raised the low end of its FY26 adj. EPS guide to $4.10-$4.20 (prior $4.05-$4.20, vs. FactSet $4.10). The raise reflects the 3Q beat and stronger margins.
FY26 organic revenue growth guidance was lowered to -2.5% to -1.5% from about -1%, citing turmoil in the Middle East. 3Q26 organic growth was -1.2%.
For 4Q, GS expects backlog conversion, continued aftermarket strength and easing 80/20 revenue headwinds to support mid-single-digit organic growth and further sequential margin expansion.

For FY27, GS sees a favorable growth setup. Record backlog gives visibility into mid-single-digit organic growth, supported by energy and nuclear demand and possible upside from deferred North American refinery maintenance.
Middle East uncertainty is a near-term risk. Stabilization could bring upside from recovering aftermarket activity and rebuild opportunities.
GS sees scope for margin expansion in FY27 from potential Middle East normalization in FCD, Trillium synergies, continued 80/20 actions and footprint consolidation.
GS raised FY26/FY27/FY28 EPS estimates by $0.05 each year, to $4.15/$4.60/$5.05, on greater confidence in execution and improved backlog visibility.
Rating stays Neutral. The 12-month price target moves to $87 from $81, on a target multiple of 12.5x (from 12.0x) to reflect a stronger growth outlook. Upside to the $71.81 price is 21.2%.
GS forecasts FY26 revenue of $4,849mn, EBITDA of $897.6mn and EBIT margin of 16.2%, with FY27 revenue growth of 6.5%.
Shares are down 15.6% over 6 months and up 36.4% over 12 months in absolute terms. Over 3 months they are down 2.2%.

market_movers.rationale: Price target raised to $87 from $81 on a higher target multiple of 12.5x and a stronger growth outlook. Rating stays Neutral despite 21.2% implied upside.

earnings_insights: FLS 3Q26 adj. EPS reported $1.07. Segment EBIT beat FactSet consensus by 5%, and FPD EBIT beat consensus by 7%.
FY26 adj. EPS guidance, company-issued, narrowed to $4.10-$4.20 from $4.05-$4.20. GS estimate is now $4.15 (old $4.10), and the prior FactSet consensus was $4.10.
GS estimates: FY27E EPS $4.60 (old $4.55) and FY28E EPS $5.05 (old $5.00). 4Q26E EPS is $1.28, 1Q27E is $0.97 and 2Q27E is $1.06.
FY26 organic revenue growth guidance was cut to -2.5% to -1.5% from about -1% on Middle East turmoil. GS FY26E revenue was trimmed to $4,849.3mn from $4,868.4mn.
risk_factors: Downside risks named by GS: 80/20 margin initiatives fall short, lackluster OE orders, dilutive M&A.
Near-term Middle East uncertainty weighing on organic revenue.
geopolitical: Turmoil in the Middle East lowered FLS's FY26 organic revenue growth expectations and is a near-term risk. Stabilization could help aftermarket recovery and rebuild opportunities.
